# FitFile

> Free online tools. No signup, no watermark, nothing uploaded. 86 small browser-only tools. Everything runs client-side, nothing is uploaded.

Agents: tools that take only numbers or text can be pre-filled by URL, e.g. `https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/emi-calculator/?principal=500000&rate=9&years=5&run=1`. Field ids are in [api.json](https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/api.json). Browsers with WebMCP (navigator.modelContext) get every tool registered automatically. Details: [for AI agents](https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/for-ai.html).

## Tools

- [Resize Image to KB](https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/resize-image-to-kb/): Make a photo smaller than a size limit, like 50 KB. (needs a file picked in the browser)
- [Compress Image](https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/compress-image/): Shrink JPG, PNG or WebP with a quality slider. (needs a file picked in the browser)
- [Resize Image](https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/resize-image/): Change width and height in pixels or percent. (needs a file picked in the browser)
- [Convert Image Format](https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/convert-image/): Convert between JPG, PNG and WebP. (needs a file picked in the browser)
- [HEIC to JPG](https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/heic-to-jpg/): Convert iPhone HEIC photos to JPG. (needs a file picked in the browser)
- [Rotate & Flip Image](https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/rotate-flip-image/): Rotate 90° or flip an image. (needs a file picked in the browser)
- [Remove Photo Metadata (EXIF)](https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/remove-image-metadata/): Strip location and camera data from a photo. (needs a file picked in the browser)
- [Add Watermark to Image](https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/add-watermark-to-image/): Put your own text watermark on a photo. (needs a file picked in the browser)
- [Image to Base64](https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/image-to-base64/): Turn an image into a Base64 data URL. (needs a file picked in the browser)
- [Passport Photo Maker](https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/passport-photo-maker/): Crop a photo to passport size and print sheet. (needs a file picked in the browser)
- [Signature Cleaner](https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/signature-cleaner/): Make a photo of your signature transparent. (needs a file picked in the browser)
- [Image Colour Picker](https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/image-color-picker/): Click a photo to get its HEX and RGB colour. (needs a file picked in the browser)
- [Compress PDF](https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/compress-pdf/): Shrink a PDF under a size limit like 200 KB. (needs a file picked in the browser)
- [Merge PDF](https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/merge-pdf/): Join several PDFs into one, in your order. (needs a file picked in the browser)
- [Split PDF / Extract Pages](https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/split-pdf/): Keep only the pages you pick. (needs a file picked in the browser)
- [Remove Pages from PDF](https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/remove-pdf-pages/): Delete unwanted pages from a PDF. (needs a file picked in the browser)
- [Image to PDF](https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/image-to-pdf/): Turn photos into one PDF, with optional size limit. (needs a file picked in the browser)
- [JPG to PDF](https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/jpg-to-pdf/): Turn photos into one PDF, with optional size limit. (needs a file picked in the browser)
- [PDF to JPG](https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/pdf-to-jpg/): Turn every PDF page into a JPG image. (needs a file picked in the browser)
- [Rotate PDF](https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/rotate-pdf/): Rotate all or some pages of a PDF. (needs a file picked in the browser)
- [Add Page Numbers to PDF](https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/add-page-numbers-to-pdf/): Number every page of a PDF. (needs a file picked in the browser)
- [Add Watermark to PDF](https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/pdf-watermark/): Stamp text across every page. (needs a file picked in the browser)
- [PDF to Text](https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/pdf-to-text/): Copy the text out of a PDF. (needs a file picked in the browser)
- [EMI Calculator](https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/emi-calculator/): Monthly EMI, total interest and payoff for any loan. (works from URL parameters)
- [SIP Calculator](https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/sip-calculator/): Future value of a monthly SIP at an expected return. (works from URL parameters)
- [Compound Interest Calculator](https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/compound-interest-calculator/): Growth of a lump sum with compounding. (works from URL parameters)
- [Simple Interest Calculator](https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/simple-interest-calculator/): Interest = P × R × T ÷ 100. (works from URL parameters)

- [CAGR Calculator](https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/cagr-calculator/): Compound annual growth rate between two values. (works from URL parameters)
- [GST Calculator](https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/gst-calculator/): Add or remove GST, with the current India slabs. (works from URL parameters)
- [Percentage Calculator](https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/percentage-calculator/): X% of Y, what percent, and percent change. (works from URL parameters)
- [Discount Calculator](https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/discount-calculator/): Final price after a percentage discount. (works from URL parameters)

- [Gratuity Calculator](https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/gratuity-calculator/): Gratuity from last salary and years of service. (works from URL parameters)
- [HRA Exemption Calculator](https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/hra-exemption-calculator/): Tax-free HRA under the old regime. (works from URL parameters)
- [GSTIN Validator](https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/gstin-validator/): Check a GST number format, state and checksum. (works from URL parameters)
- [PAN Format Checker](https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/pan-validator/): Check PAN structure and holder type. (works from URL parameters)
- [Rent Receipt Generator](https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/rent-receipt-generator/): Monthly rent receipts as a PDF, for HRA claims. (works from URL parameters)
- [Invoice Generator](https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/invoice-generator/): Create a clean invoice PDF, with optional GST. (works from URL parameters)
- [BMI Calculator](https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/bmi-calculator/): Body mass index from height and weight. (works from URL parameters)
- [Age Calculator](https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/age-calculator/): Exact age in years, months and days. (works from URL parameters)
- [Days Between Dates](https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/days-between-dates/): Days, weeks and working days between two dates. (works from URL parameters)

- [Length Converter](https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/length-converter/): Convert Metres, Kilometres, Centimetres, Millimetres and more. (works from URL parameters)

- [Volume Converter](https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/volume-converter/): Convert Litres, Millilitres, Cubic metres, US gallons and more. (works from URL parameters)
- [Speed Converter](https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/speed-converter/): Convert Kilometres per hour, Metres per second, Miles per hour, Knots and more. (works from URL parameters)
- [Time Converter](https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/time-converter/): Convert Seconds, Minutes, Hours, Days and more. (works from URL parameters)
- [Temperature Converter](https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/temperature-converter/): Celsius, Fahrenheit and Kelvin. (works from URL parameters)
- [Data Size Converter](https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/data-size-converter/): Bytes, KB, MB, GB and TB. (works from URL parameters)
- [Number to Words](https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/number-to-words/): Write amounts in words, Indian or international. (works from URL parameters)
- [Roman Numeral Converter](https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/roman-numeral-converter/): Numbers to Roman numerals and back. (works from URL parameters)
- [Number Base Converter](https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/number-base-converter/): Binary, octal, decimal and hexadecimal. (works from URL parameters)
- [Colour Converter](https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/color-converter/): HEX, RGB and HSL with a colour picker. (works from URL parameters)
- [Unix Timestamp Converter](https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/unix-timestamp-converter/): Epoch seconds or milliseconds to a date, and back. (works from URL parameters)
